title.en: Find Areas That Were Warm More Than Once

brief.zh: 先选出所有偏暖读数，再找出偏暖读数至少出现两次的区域。
brief.en: Select the warm readings, then find the areas where warm temperatures occurred at least twice.

concept.zh: WHERE 先筛行，分组汇总后用 HAVING 再筛组。
concept.en: Use WHERE to select individual rows, then use HAVING to select groups after aggregation.

hints.zh: 第一步保留区域和记录编号等所有列。第二步给每区计数，再保留计数至少为 2 的区域。
hints.en: Keep all columns, including area and ID, in the first step. Then count by area and keep groups with at least two readings.

prompt.zh: 保留所有温度至少 24°C 的记录，显示所有列，按编号排列。
prompt.en: Return all readings at 24°C or above, keeping all columns, in ID order.

prompt.zh: 使用上一步的结果，找出偏暖读数至少 2 次的区域。按偏暖次数从多到少排列。
prompt.en: Use the previous result to find areas with at least two warm readings. Sort by number of warm readings, highest first.
